GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 560 (29 Jan 47) GC
(SCAPIN - 1497)
APO 500
29 January 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Processing Japanese Crew Members of United States Owned Ships Which Have Been Released from Repatriation Service.
1. Reference is made to memorandum from the Supreme Coriander for the Allied Powers, file AG 560 (14 Dec 46)GC, (SCAPIN 1403), dated 14 December 1946, subject as above.
2. Repatriation ship John C. Ainsworth, VH-004, is scheduled to arrive at Uraga on or about 4 February 1946. Ship is carrying 1118 crew members of former Japanese operated ships which have been released from repatriation service and returned to the United States.
3. The Imperial Japanese Government will process these returning crew members and their baggage and personal possessions in accordance with the provisions of memorandum referred to in paragraph 1 above.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
